reviews.review_description: as the above comments have detailed will be talking to sundrop when i think i need a battery

Right from the start , getting information and quotes , Kevin was very helpful and explained everything to me .Very happy with their service and installation was very professional and they cleaned up after they had finished

The initial education from Solarquotes was really helpful, even for myself as an electrical engineer who does not work in the field of renewables. Solarquotes was able to recommend two firms for my area in Perth. Sundrop Electricals were able to answer all my questions, and they have a good level of technical knowledge on domestic solar systems. From all of my enquiries, I received 2 quotes, mostly due to businesses being too busy and also not too interested as I wasn't buying a battery system as well. I chose the Sundrop Electricals' proposal for the combination of Jinko panels and the 10 kVA Fronius Gen24 Inverter.All interaction required with our energy provider was done by the Sundrop team, so the process was easy.The installation process was consultative, and the workmanship is of a high level. All of the team was polite and due to the size of the team, it only took 6 hours. The system handover and supplied documentation were done well. There was no hurry to just abandon me with the new system. I have received all required electrical notices from the regulator and they initiated the energy retailer processes as well.I can recommend Sam and Shane from Sundrop. They are passionate about renewable energy and take pride in their work and business.

Other installers sent quotes without vsiting our home.  Sam from Sundrop was great, he explained his quote, checked that our tiles (which are quite old) we in good condition to allow installation of the panels and talked through our options.  We actually chose a more expensive solution than he recommended just because we wanted total integration with our vehicle charging, and Sundrop did not push this solution.Sam has been responsive and completed all work as scheduled.  He connected everything through the wifi app and registered and setup everyhting for us, including the car charger.We highly recommend Sundrop and Sam to any prospective solar customers..

Shane and his team were punctual polite and respectful. They worked diligently completed the installation and cleaned up the debris. I have no hesitation in recommending Sundrop to people looking for quality.

Sundrop Electricals provided expert advice in an easy to understand manner and installed a fit for purpose system for us. They were cost competitive, used quality components and made the whole process straightforward. We have already recommended them to family.

The quotation process with Kevin went very well.Shane and his team arrived on time for the installation, all installed quickly and efficiently.Shane setup the Sungrow inverter app on my phone.So, in all a very good experience with Sundrop Electrical.

Gave good quote explaining my choice in quality and price. No issue with installation which was done promptly and surprised by how quick it was done. excellent after service provided where they completed all relevant paperwork.

We have been putting off getting solar for a long time. But a chat with Sam changed our minds. He went over the details, very thorough and was patient in answering all our questions. Thanks Sam and Shane for your professionalism and excellent customer service!

Really knowledgeable sales person who was happy to answer all of our questions. Quick turnaround from quote to install.Installation crew was very impressive, it was clear they had a lot of pride in their work and in providing a high quality service.Grid connection was done straight away.Very impressed with their service, quality of work and fast turnaround. Highly recommended!

The sales quoting process was very efficient and detailed. The installation team were punctual, polite and very efficient. They did all the ‘go between’ paperwork between us and the energy supplier. They were very patient in explaining how the system works and answered all questions. Very impressed with this company and would certainly recommend them to others.

SunDrop electrical made the process of selecting and installing solar very easy.Re sales - Kevin D was helpful but not pushy and explained all my options very clearly .Shane and his installation team were excellent, installing the system on time, quickly and efficiently. Clean up afterwards was good and Shane clearly explained the set up and use of the system to me before they left.Follow up support has also been excellent including returning to check things when I had concerns.I would highly recommend SunDrop Electricals.
GreatNice and tidy and polite and helpful bunch of guysNo issues with customer service.

Team brought great value and service. I had no issues dealing with Shankar, from initial chat and  sharing quotes to installation, his team delivered top-notched service. Appreciate Shankar’s great service in-between when I had questions about the available systems and about solar installation. He answered all my questions with great detail. I highly recommend Sundrop Electricals, Shankar is a very good person and you can see he cares not only for himself and for his customers as well. Highly recommended.

I was recommended by a relative who has their solar installed by Shane from Sundrop Electricals, and I am glad I chose them for installing my solar. Shane is very professional throughout from the quote to the installation and made sure everything was set up correctly.
Very happy with sales and service by this company. All good.

The installer Shane was amazing to deal with.Right from quoting,pricing to installation .All required paper work and permission process was seamless.The offered price was competitive.His team ensured we downloaded the correct app and set it up correctly.Highly recommended for stree free solar pricing and installation.
Excellent customer service and installation. Loving my new solar system.
Everything was easy from start to finish.We are very happy with the result

Very good service from quote to completion of job.Unit works well and works as it should.The team were quick, polite, tidy and professional.They have professionally installed multiple units for friends and family as we highly recommend to anyone looking for solar panels.A job well done ?

Shankar and his team install solar on two of our properties and a friend's home.Quotes were accurate and no hidden costs. One property came in under the quote given, so it was even cheaper.He's honest, reliable and clean and tidy.I would definitely recommend Shankar and his team.

The team approached the sale calmly with no pressure. Price competitive and provided good no fuss installation service. We had a challenging roof for them to feed the conduits but they did the job automatically and efficiently.

Had solar panels and a battery system installed recently, and I’m very happy with the result. The team was professional, efficient, and answered all my questions. The installation was smooth, and they left everything clean. I’ve already noticed a drop in my energy bills, and I’m glad to be using renewable energy. Highly recommend.
Easy to work with, on time and efficient. Would be happy to recommend

Great job Thanks Kevin for your prompted and professional service.Thanks Shane great installation clean and tidy and answered all my questions.I highly recommend SunDrop Electricals solar.This is one of 2 houses I have had throw SunDrop Electricals and would not hesitate to use them again.
These guys are excellent.  I'm very happy with my new Solar System. Sundrop are polite and efficient and did a great installation job. Highly recommended.

Shankar is exactly what you would expect from a professional tradesman. His organisational skills and attention to detail are second to none. The whole process including the install was completely hassle free and I would highly recommend this company to anyone.

Installed a 6.6kW system and had it all sorted within a few weeks. Salesperson was helpful with layouts on roof and some minor concerns for the install including potential shading from a pipe. Price was the best we received, and proposal was by far the most straight-forward. Didn't feel like we were being oversold.Install team arrived and completed the job quickly and efficiently, despite being caught in some sudden but reasonable heavy rain for a short period. Install is neat and tidy, and all work areas were cleaned up went the job was completed.
Sundrop did an amazing job installing our solar system. The team was professional, quick, and Shane made the whole process easy. Highly recommend them for anyone in WA!

We have been working on our quotation for a bit and change different combinations, and our sales person Kevin always offers a prompt quotation and explain clean everything to us.Once we decide to install, Shane offers the great service and it all comes with great benefits! So professional and helpful!

Needed a replacement inverter when the original one malfunctioned and I was getting nowhere with the original installer. Shane gave me a competitive quote for a replacement inverter and the job was done promptly and efficiently and we were back up and producing electricity again in no time flat.   All in all a good service from Sundrop Electricals.

Kevin was incredibly fast and professional with all communications and was able to offer a competitive price. Shane doing the installations with his team was very much the same! Would definitely recommend

Quoting process was easy and over the phone Kevin was very knowledgeable.Sundrops quote was the cheapest quote we received but also offered the best rated inverter and panels as reviewed by solar quotes.Installation went smoothly, they did arrived with different rails but offered to reduce the price or go get them I was happy to reduce the price.Shane also walked me through the system and helped me setup the monitoring app.Would definitely recommend and will provide an update in a year but 2 days in the system is already producing lots of excess power that we are selling to the grid.
We were recommended Shane through our neighbour. He was very prompt and responsive and went above and beyond. Highly recommend.

Quoting process was over the phone and simple due to the simplicity of my install. Of the three quotes they were the cheapest by a decent margin.Installation was done in a morning and besides breaking a couple of tiles (it’s an old roof and I keep half a dozen spares anyway) there was no issue at all.My only gripe would be the lack of communication for about a week after signing the contract and having to call to lock in an installation date.All-in-all I’m very happy with the process.

Overall the sales person who got in contact with me was very personable quick to answer everything and explain it all.The installation team came in at the time requested put it together super fast cleaned up after themselves and were great at explaining everything too. 10/10 there.Customer service went really well in general, polite, quick, followed up, kind when I said I was getting other quotes and patient waiting for me to get back to them.Thanks guys.
Very Good business to deal with. Received quote very quickly. Installation completed within few days.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Shane to install a 10.56kW solar PV system, complete with a Sungrow Hybrid inverter and a 12.8kWh battery. From start to finish, Shane's professionalism, patience, and expert knowledge made the entire process a breeze. His attention to detail resulted in a clean and neat installation that exceeded my expectations. The excellent post-installation support he provided further solidified my confidence in his services. I wholeheartedly recommend Shane for anyone seeking a top-notch solar PV system installer.But that's not all! I am so impressed with Shane's work that I've decided to expand my battery system to 25.6kWh, and I have every intention of having Shane handle the installation. With his expertise and dedication to quality, I have no doubt that the expansion will be just as exceptional as the initial installation. Shane has truly earned my trust, and I couldn't be happier with the service he provided.
Reasonably priced very good installer. Quick and detail quotation. Turned up on time for site visit. Installation crew were very friendly. Would recomment to everyone.
quoting awesomeinstallation very friendly and great customer service.would definitely recommend them.

Thank you, Team Sundrop.Extremely smooth process from start to finish. Quote had all information and multiple options. Fast and clear communication. A Very helpful and friendly installation team. I wanted Solar on my shed which had no power. Sundrop boys ran underground power, installed sub-board into shed so that I can get what I want.Highly recommended.

Good and polite sales staff. Got call for Quote, Mr. Shane did site visit, Checked everything and sent quote on next day. Finished installation as planned. Customer service was good. Will see how we are going to get support in the future.

After dealing with other companies, sundrop is the best for sales and after installation requirements, they are very punctual and professional in all aspectsGet job completed guys, keep up the good workPat
